response.overview: The creation of the animated performance capture movie 'Monster House (2006)' is divided in 7 parts: "Imaginary Heroes (3:32)" It's about the creation of the characters and the buildings. "Beginner's Luck (2:29)" The luck of the director to get his all actors and actresses of his wish list. "The Best of Friends (2:44)" This part is about the friendship of the 2 main actors. "Lots of Dots (2:31)" Here you see how the cast has to prepared for the performance capture. "Black Box Theater (4:16)" Here is explained how performance capture works. You learn about T-pose and how the props are made and the set is constructed. "Making it Real (6:06)" A detailed explanation of the animation process. "Did You Hear That? (2:58)" How does a house sound? You hear it here together with all other sound design.
response.title: Inside Monster House
